question: Which of the following banks launched a special debit card for visually impaired customers in October 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Punjab National Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Punjab National Bank (PNB)** launched a special debit card for **visually impaired customers** in October 2024.
 
• This initiative aims to promote **financial inclusion** and make banking services more **accessible** to individuals with visual impairments.
 
• The debit card is designed with **Braille features** to help visually impaired users recognize and operate it independently.
 
• It allows visually impaired customers to conduct **secure transactions** such as cash withdrawals, balance inquiries, and purchases.
 
• The move aligns with PNB’s commitment to empowering people with **disabilities** and catering to their specific banking needs.
 
• PNB is one of the leading public sector banks in India, with a history of implementing **customer-focused solutions**.
 
• This innovative debit card is part of the bank's efforts to comply with the **Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016**, which emphasizes equal access to services for people with disabilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **HDFC Bank**__

 __
 
• **HDFC Bank** is one of the largest private sector banks in India.
 
• It is known for offering a wide range of **digital banking products** and **innovative financial services**.
 
• HDFC Bank focuses on enhancing **digital accessibility** but has not specifically launched a debit card for visually impaired customers.
 
 
 
• **State Bank of India (SBI)**__
 __
 
• **SBI** is the largest public sector bank in India and provides financial services to a vast customer base.
 
• SBI has a history of introducing **specialized products**, such as loans for women and farmers, but it has not launched a debit card exclusively for visually impaired customers.
 
 
 
• **Canara Bank**__
 
 
• **Canara Bank** is another major public sector bank in India.
 
• It offers a variety of **banking products** and services, including debit and credit cards, but there is no record of it introducing a debit card specifically for visually impaired customers.
